info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Payments-v5-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Payment Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about payment statuses related to education enrollments. This API is designed for educational institutions and administrative offices that manage student payments. With this endpoint, organizations can efficiently fetch payment records, facilitating timely financial oversight and transparency. Typical consumers of this API include school administrators, finance departments, and software developers integrating payment management functionalities into educational platforms.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details regarding the payment associated with enrollments. It provides insights into the payment status and related data that are essential for understanding and managing enrollment fees.
